name: Ulvetime
source:
In the middle of nowhere, Mikhail awakens to a world painted in gray.
Relics of the past with faded colours and broken ruins are all but living. He looks around only to find nothing but nearly expired rations and funky tasting water.

Only to be greeted by a creature made of concrete and flesh.

Enter in the world of Ulvetime as Mikhail, as you wander around finding the reasons why everything is so bleak and gray. Maybe you'll even figure out how to save the world.

[From [url=https://salthymn.itch.io/ulvetime]Itch.io[/url]]
